title: Delivery
description: Delivery record: send this content to this recipient. The core creates it in the transaction of the transition that produces it (DLV-2), and the channel, sink or monitoring adapter that takes it through P1 claim sends it. The address comes only from a closed list (DLV-6); the core computes the target from the address, and the addressee's worker does not compute it. A delivery has its own leases, retries and final outcome; its failure does not touch the task (DLV-3). Delivery lifecycle: spec/lifecycles/delivery.md.

kind.description: Delivery kind: a value from the registry delivery-kinds.yaml (task_result, card_update, ai_notice, privacy_notice, script_summary, monitor_alarm, monitor_audit_head, monitor_script, monitor_note) or, for a decision card and a notice to people, the id of a row in decision-points.yaml (for example script_confirm). The core code and the recipient worker branch on the kind.

to.description: Address from a closed list (DLV-6): origin, group:<group>, chat:<binding>, sink:<sink>, approval_initiator, monitor (the E5 monitoring adapter, only alarms, scripts and notes), insights.present_to or admins (the direct chats of the tenant admins with the right a code notice names, set only by the core). There are no addresses in the task body, result, bot messages or event data.

target.description: The recipient that the core computes from the address: a channel chat, a recipient principal, a sink or the tenant's monitoring adapter (DLV-6). The delivery executor process calls it work-item payload.target, and the chat for the channel work-item delivery.recipient. For kind: chat the id field has the form <direct|group>:<external chat id>.

task.description: The task whose transition produced the delivery.

dataorigin.description: Data origin mark: model if the model wrote the text, otherwise code; only the core sets it (DLV-13).

notice_version.description: Only privacy_notice: the notice version from the tenant's privacy block.

external_id.description: External id of the sent message; for a card, card_update uses it to edit the message instead of sending a new one (FEN-7).

attempts.description: Spent delivery attempts; the ceiling is set by the channel binding within the farm ceiling.

reason.description: Reason for withheld or dead from the reason registry, for example channel_ceiling, unknown_member, recipient_inactive, no_data_class, held, ai_notice_dead, secret_in_outbound, attempts_exhausted, exec_unknown.
